cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-飞行自动化系统-1
cards.audioText: Which automated systems are commonly used in a modern cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 现代驾驶舱通常使用哪些自动化系统？
cards.referenceText: Common automated cockpit systems include the autopilot, autothrottle, and autoland system.
cards.referenceTextZh: 常见的驾驶舱自动化系统包括自动驾驶仪、自动油门和自动着陆系统。

cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-飞行自动化系统-2
cards.audioText: How reliable are modern cockpit automation systems?
cards.audioTextZh: 现代驾驶舱自动化系统的可靠性如何？
cards.referenceText: Modern cockpit automation systems are generally very reliable. Many systems have backup capability, so another system may be available if one becomes inoperative.
cards.referenceTextZh: 现代驾驶舱自动化系统通常非常可靠。许多系统具有备份能力，因此一个系统失效时，可能还有另一个系统可用。

cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-飞行自动化系统-3
cards.audioText: What is the role of pilots in today's highly automated cockpits?
cards.audioTextZh: 在当今高度自动化的驾驶舱中，飞行员发挥什么作用？
cards.referenceText: In a highly automated cockpit, pilots manage and monitor the systems that help control the aircraft. Their role includes making sure the automation is operating as intended.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在高度自动化的驾驶舱中，飞行员负责管理和监控协助控制飞机的系统。他们的职责包括确保自动化系统按预期工作。

cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-飞行自动化系统-4
cards.audioText: Do you think pilots have become too dependent on automation, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为飞行员是否变得过度依赖自动化？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I think some pilots have become too dependent on automation. Automated systems perform much of the routine aircraft control, so pilots may spend more time monitoring and managing those systems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我认为一些飞行员已经过度依赖自动化。自动化系统承担了大量日常飞机操纵任务，因此飞行员可能把更多时间用于监控和管理这些系统。
